title: Phone does not receive readings or it lost a lot of them
symptom: User reports that after first four days of working perfectly, the phone (Aquarius U) intermittently stops receiving readings from the FreeStyle sensor via Blucon; at night it loses many readings, with only a few values over hours, and sometimes only initial readings or a single reading before stopping.
cause: The developers examined logs and their opinion so far is that there is probably a fault with the Blucon device. No definitive root cause was confirmed; the problem later resolved on its own without explanation.
evidence_quote: The developers have looked over the logs and the opinion so far is that there is probably a fault with the blucon device.
